C0589.title: Yan'an Yonghui Supermarket Xuanyuan Avenue Branch Price Fraud Case
C0589.summary: In April 2022, Shaanxi market regulation authorities investigated a batch of illegal cases, among which Yan'an Yonghui Supermarket Xuanyuan Avenue Branch was fined 100,000 yuan for fabricating original prices and committing price fraud. The case was listed as a typical example in that month's trending legal events.
